note: Scores typed by hand before the DBBF export carries them, keyed by DBBF game id, always as us/them. build-fixtures.py reads us/them and marks the game played; the export wins as soon as it has its own score. A box entry is the Men's box score for the details panel on /games (Deng, 8 Sep 2026: Men only, full box score; youth games carry a score and nothing else). Columns: num, name, min, pts, ft, fg (made field goals), pf. A null cell prints blank, and a num or min column with no value in any row is left off the table. An under 18 gets a first name only, a null min and a null pf, and totals.pf stays null on any game with an under 18 so the sum cannot give his fouls away. Added 15 Sep 2026 for the Hørsholm replay: annulled true keeps the score and box on the site, tagged Annulled, never shown as a win and never picked as the next game (Deng: keep both stats). note is public text for the details panel. ot true prints OT beside the score. fixture holds date, time, team, opponent, home, competition, venue and court for a game the export does not have yet; build-fixtures.py adds it as a row with source results, and the export row wins the day it carries the id.
